item.tib: byings kyi le'u 'dod 'byung nor bu'i mgul rgyan dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i mchod sprin
item.coloph: 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i byings kyi rnam grangs zhib par chig stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu 1940tsam yod pa 'di nyid/ sngon gyi rtag gzigs rgya zhang bod sogs kyi lo paN chen po a nu b+hA ti (dbyangs can sgra mdo (mchan) )dang pA Ni pa dang tsan+d+ra go mi/ bde spyod rgyal po/ (ka lA sa cha bsag gi mdo (mchan) )jo bo grags 'byor/ (ka lA pa'i 'grel pa (mchan) )byang chub rtse mo/ (byings (mchan) )gang ba'i zla ba/ (byings (mchan) )bgrod dka' seng ge (byings (mchan) sogs kyis bzhed gzhung rnam dag du ma'i legs bcud phyungs te/ (byings 'ga' zhig nyis ldab dang sum ldab 'dug kyang dgos pa'i dbang gis gzhung don kho na bzhin bkod do/ mchan lta bu'o/)gshen gyi drang srong 'jigs med nam mkha'i rdo rje'am/ skad gnyis smra ba sgra rig pa rgyal kun dgyes pa'i blo gros zhes bya bas/ mi mjed zhing mgon skur bltams nas deng skabs 'byung ldan sum brgya'i nang tshan shing pho rta lo'i rgyal zla'i tshes bcu gsum nyin dbu mjug yongs su grub par bgyis pa'i dge des 'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba rang sar grol te tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i dpal la mnga' bsnyems shing mtha' bral dbu ma'i gzhi ru byang chub pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
